name: Drill Rotom (CobbleEffort form)
look: a tracked drilling rig with an orange drill mast and a one-eyed drilling head full of grinding teeth
entry: This Rotom has taken over a drilling rig. It chews through bedrock with its grinding teeth and leaves tunnels so neat that miners follow them home.
how: Use a Drill Engine on your Rotom (craft it round a Cell Battery; needs Mega Showdown); its Rotom Catalogue cycles through this form too. Learns Steel Beam in this form.
